part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Languages
questions: How many languages can you speak? [Why/Why not?]
How useful will English be to you in your future? [Why/Why not?]
What do you remember about learning languages at school? [Why/Why not?]
What do you think would be the hardest language for you to learn? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a website that you bought something from.
points: what you bought from this website
how satisfied you were with what you bought
part2.closing: and explain what you liked or disliked about using this website.

topics.title: Shopping online
questions: What kinds of things do people in your country often buy from online shops?
Why do you think online shopping has become so popular nowadays?
What are some possible disadvantages of buying things from online shops?

topics.title: The culture of consumerism
questions: Why do many people today keep buying things which they do not need?
Do you believe the benefits of a consumer society outweigh the disadvantages?
How possible is it to avoid the culture of consumerism?
